segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Hello.
Hello, can you hear me?
Yes, I can hear you. Tell me.
Did you eat? What are you doing?
I am from which place?
I am from Pudukkottai.
Oh, okay, okay.
What is your name?
Jasmin.
Oh, nice name.
Thank you. What are you doing?
I am just resting, I am free.
Okay, okay.
What work?
Me? What are you asking?
Are you asking if I ate? What did you ask?
What are you doing?
I am a housewife, I am doing household chores.
Okay, okay.
Is everyone at home doing well?
What is special today?
Nothing special. What is special for lunch today? Why are you asking me?
Yes, it is curd rice today.
Oh, okay. Are you a bachelor?
No, no.
Then eat curd rice. Curd rice is good for this heat.
Even if it is curd rice, it is a bit stressful.
Whatever it is, curd is curd.
I am a bachelor, so I can only eat curd rice.
You can go to a shop and buy biryani and eat, right?
That requires a budget, right?
Yes, that is also needed. It costs 200 or 300 rupees for food.
Yes.
Since when have you been using this app?
I downloaded this yesterday.
I downloaded it, and just now they called for verification.
Calls are coming after verification.
Oh.
They are asking why I am talking on calls. I must have made ten calls.
I just downloaded it. An elder sister told me to download this app.
I just downloaded it and saw that calls are coming.
Are they talking properly?
Everyone talks well, but they don't talk to me 100%.
They talk like that.
Are they talking rudely?
Yes.
They talk about that.
What did they say?
They ask if I like sex, can we do it, and all that.
That is what they are asking. What else will they talk about?
Let it be, what to do?
Yes, we have to do it.
It has come. I know they will talk like this.
Then what to do? I have to talk and go.
If I don't talk, nothing is going to happen. I have to talk and go.
